title: Organic vs Paid Social Media: How to Use Both (2026)

facts.fact: Cost per mille (CPM) is the platform billing rate per 1,000 impressions.
facts.quote: Cost per mille (CPM) bills every 1,000 impressions.

facts.fact: Cost per click (CPC) is the platform billing model where the advertiser pays for each click on an ad.
facts.quote: Cost per click (CPC) bills each click.

facts.fact: Click-through rate (CTR) is calculated as clicks divided by impressions.
Organic engagement rate is calculated as interactions divided by reach.
